title: Bedhead Attractor
description: The Bedhead Attractor is a chaotic attractor defined by the following equations: x_{n+1} = sin(x \cdot y/b) \cdot y + cos(a \cdot x - y), y_{n+1} = x + sin(y)/b

title: Bogdanov Map
description: The Bogdanov Map (Rifkat Bogdanov) is the discrete map y' = y + a y + b x(x-1) + \mu x y, x' = x + y' with defaults a=0.0025, b=1.44, \mu=-0.1.

title: Brusselator (ODE)
description: Well-mixed Brusselator ODEs drawn as a phase-orbit trail (Euler step): dx/dt = a-(b+1)x+x^2 y, dy/dt = bx-x^2 y. Not a spatial reaction–diffusion field.

title: Clifford Attractor
description: The Clifford Attractor is a chaotic attractor defined by the following equations: x_{n+1} = sin(a \cdot y_n) + c \cdot cos(a \cdot x_n), y_{n+1} = sin(b \cdot x_n) + d \cdot cos(b \cdot y_n)

title: Fractal Dream Attractor
description: The Fractal Dream Attractor is a chaotic attractor defined by the following equations: x_{n+1} = sin(y_n \cdot b) + c \cdot sin(x_n \cdot b), y_{n+1} = sin(x_n \cdot a) + d \cdot sin(y_n \cdot a)

title: Gumowski-Mira Attractor
description: Gumowski–Mira attractor: x' = y + a(1-b y²)y + G(x,μ), y' = -x + G(x',μ), with G(x,μ)=μx + 2(1-μ)x²/(1+x²).

title: Henon Map
description: Classic Hénon map (1976): x' = 1 - a x² + y, y' = b x. Defaults a=1.4, b=0.3.

title: Hopalong Attractor
description: Barry Martin's classic Hopalong (1981): x' = y - sgn(x)√|b x - c|, y' = a - x. Defaults a=1.4, b≈5.16, c≈2.74.

title: Hopalong Attractor Positive
description: Martin positive Hopalong: x' = y + sgn(x)√|b x - c|, y' = a - x. Same a,b,c knobs as classic.

title: Hopalong Attractor Additive
description: Martin additive Hopalong: x' = y + √|b x - c|, y' = a - x (no sign flip). Same a,b,c knobs as classic.

title: Hopalong Attractor Sinusoidal
description: Martin sinusoidal Hopalong: x' = y + sin(b x - c), y' = a - x. Same a,b,c knobs as classic.

title: Gingerbread Man
description: The Gingerbread Man (or Gingerbreadman) map is a chaotic 2D system defined by x_{n+1} = 1 - y_n + |x_n|, y_{n+1} = x_n. Its orbit often resembles a gingerbread figure.

title: Ikeda Map
description: Ikeda map (param a): f = 0.4 - 6/(1+x²+y²), x' = 1 + a(x cos f − y sin f), y' = a(x sin f + y cos f).

title: Lorenz Attractor
description: Classic 3D Lorenz system rendered as a GPU line trail (green→white): dx/dt = σ(y-x), dy/dt = x(ρ-z)-y, dz/dt = xy-βz with σ=10, ρ=28, β=8/3.

title: Aizawa Attractor
description: 3D Aizawa ODE trail (cool→warm): round shell with a funnel through the axis. Knobs a–f and dt; archive-style defaults a=0.95, b=0.7, c=0.6, d=3.5, e=0.25, f=0.1, dt=0.01.

title: Mandelbrot Set
description: The Mandelbrot Set is defined by iterating z_{n+1} = z_n^2 + c for complex c; the set is those c for which the sequence remains bounded.

title: Julia Set
description: Julia sets fix a complex constant c and iterate z_{n+1} = z_n^2 + c over starting points z₀. Each c yields a different connected or dusty fractal.

title: Sierpiński Triangle
description: GPU Sierpiński gasket with scroll-zoom and drag-pan. Each pixel tests barycentric membership through recursive corner remaps until a void or max depth. Depth is screen-capped to avoid sparkles.

title: Calabi–Yau Manifold
description: Hanson 3D projection of a 2-real slice of the Fermat quintic as a particle wire. Morph degree n and projection angle a; not the full 6-real Calabi–Yau 3-fold.

title: Gyroid
description: Schoen gyroid as a particle wire: triply periodic minimal surface from sin x cos y + sin y cos z + sin z cos x = t on a 2π cell.

title: Barth Sextic
description: Barth’s degree-6 icosahedral surface as a particle wire. Morph tau (golden lattice), radius (sphere term), mix (spikes vs shell).

title: Schwarz P
description: Schwarz primitive (P) as a particle wire. Morph iso-level t and tiles on the cos x + cos y + cos z = t labyrinth.

title: Dini's Surface
description: Dini’s surface: a pseudospherical helicoid (twisted tractrix). UV isoline particle wire with radius a and twist b.

title: Roman Surface
description: Steiner’s Roman surface: RP² immersion as a UV isoline particle wire. Morph squash stretches z before normalize.

title: Enneper Surface
description: Enneper’s minimal surface as a UV isoline particle wire. Span sets |u|,|v| so the self-intersections read.

title: Boy's Surface
description: Immersion of RP² in R³ as a polar isoline wire. Morph k: Roman→Apéry Boy; bryant: Apéry→Bryant–Kusner three-balls.
